strategies.name: continuation_breakout_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: Enter on a clean break of support or resistance in an in-play stock, using tape confirmation that the level is being taken. For an upside break, buy just above the level, e.g. $10.01/$10.02 or $50.01 once buyers lift the offer and it disappears.
strategies.exit_summary: Scalp out into immediate emotional follow-through for roughly 10 to 30 cents, and use a tight stop back below the broken level if price fails the breakout.
